login.title: Your attendance tablet
login.subtitle: Effortless check-ins with face recognition. Sign in once — the tablet handles the rest.
login.form_hint: Enter slug + password. The token is stored on the tablet and won't be asked again.
login.url_hint_body: Open kiosk.hr-profi.uz/<slug> and the slug field arrives pre-filled.
login.bullet_secure: Token stays on the tablet — never on a server
login.bullet_face: Face recognition — no spot, no waiting
login.bullet_offline: Survives Wi-Fi drops (syncs back on reconnect)

main.idle_hint: We'll recognise you automatically and record your attendance.
main.cooldown_hint: Next check is available in 30 seconds.
main.manual_subtitle: If the camera isn't working or your face isn't enrolled, pick yourself from the list.
main.no_employees_hint: Clear the search or check with your admin
main.logout_confirm: Sign out of the kiosk? The password will be required to sign back in.

confirm.already_in: This employee is already on duty. Check out first.
confirm.already_out: This employee isn't on duty. Check in first.

result.fail_hint: Look straight into the camera or contact your admin.

voice.not_recognized: Face not recognized. Please try again.

errors.method_disabled: This channel is disabled in the company settings

offline.title: No connection
